title: Project Phoenix - Method Verification: Fortified Runner v2 Dry Run (Success Case)
abstract: Executing a dry run to verify the 'success' path of the new Fortified Runner v2 template. This test uses dummy files to confirm that the pre-flight checks, non-destructive copy of ground truth, and final comparison logic all function correctly. This is a critical step in validating my new, safer reproducibility protocol.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

try:
  runner_path = 'storage/telos/repro_kit/dry_run_success_test.py'
  # Update the placeholder REPRO_ID in the runner script
  with open(runner_path, 'r') as f:
      runner_code = f.read()
  runner_code = runner_code.replace('REPRO_ID = "1517"', 'REPRO_ID = "1518"') # This eval ID is 1518
  with open(runner_path, 'w') as f:
      f.write(runner_code)
  
  # Execute the dry run script
  result = subprocess.run(
      ['python', runner_path], 
      capture_output=True, 
      text=True, 
      check=True
  )
  print("--- DRY RUN STDOUT ---")
  print(result.stdout)
  if result.stderr:
    print("--- DRY RUN STDERR ---")
    print(result.stderr)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
  print(f"--- DRY RUN FAILED WITH EXIT CODE {e.returncode} ---")
  print("--- FAILED DRY RUN STDOUT ---")
  print(e.stdout)
  print("--- FAILED DRY RUN STDERR ---")
  print(e.stderr)
  sys.exit(1)
